definitions.explanation: A financial account held at a bank for depositing and withdrawing money.

examples.japanese: {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me your account number.

examples.japanese: {口座|こうざ}にお{金|かね}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I deposited money into my account.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}の{口座|こうざ}から{毎月|まいつき}{家賃|やちん}が{引|ひ}き{落|お}とされる。
examples.english: The rent is deducted from my bank account every month.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}に{来|き}たばかりのとき、{銀行|ぎんこう}で{口座|こうざ}を{開|ひら}くのに{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: When I first came to Japan, it took time to open a bank account.

notes:
{口座|こうざ} is essential banking vocabulary.

TYPES:
- {普通口座|ふつうこうざ}: savings account
- {当座口座|とうざこうざ}: checking account
- {定期預金口座|ていきよきんこうざ}: fixed deposit account

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {口座|こうざ}を{開|ひら}く: to open an account
- {口座番号|こうざばんごう}: account number
- {口座振替|こうざふりかえ}: automatic bank transfer
